# Code Diff > Unified or split diff from a git patch or a before/after pair, with word-level intra-line highlighting. This file matches the installed `code-diff` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/code-diff.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/code-diff.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@tanstack/react-virtual@^3.14.28` - `diff@^9.0.0` - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `code` - `core` - `scroll-area` - `tooltip` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/code-diff-knobs`: `codeDiffKnobs`, types `CodeDiffKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/lib/diff`: `computeWordDiff`, `diffRunEnd`, `buildDiffFromFiles`, `buildDiffFromPatch`, `hiddenContext`, `diffLinePosition`, `linesInRange`, types `CodeDiffLineType`, `CodeLineType`, `LineDiffType`, `DiffFileType`, `DiffSegment`, `DiffLine`, `DiffHunk`, `DiffFile`, `DiffSide`, `DiffLinePoint`, `DiffLineRange`, `CodeDiffAnnotation`, `BuildDiffOptions` - `@/components/control-ui/code-diff-selection`: `diffLineKey`, `useDiffLineSelection`, types `DiffLineColumn`, `DiffLineTarget`, `DiffLineButtonProps`, `DiffLineSelection` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/code-diff`: `CodeDiff`, `CodeDiffCopy`, types `CodeDiffAnnotation`, `DiffLinePoint`, `DiffLineRange`, `DiffSide`, `DiffStyle`, `DiffIndicators`, `DiffLineKind`, `CodeDiffLineRole`, `CodeDiffProps`, `CodeDiffCopyProps` ## Composition ### Rendered diff Pass a patch or oldText/newText. CodeDiff renders the files and its copy action internally. ```tsx built-in header actions ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import type { DiffStyle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/code-diff"; import { CodeDiff } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/code-diff"; const OLD = `export function greet(name) { const message = "Hello, " + name; console.log(message); return message; }`; const NEW = `export function greet(name: string) { const message = \`Hello, \${name}!\`; return message; }`; const PATCH = `diff --git a/src/utils.ts b/src/utils.ts --- a/src/utils.ts +++ b/src/utils.ts @@ -1,3 +1,3 @@ export function slugify() export function slugify(input: string) { - return input.toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, "-"); + return input.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, "-"); } `; export function PrimitiveCodeDiffExample() { const [style, setStyle] = useState("split"); return (
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `code-diff` - `accessible-source` - `actions` - `annotation` - `body` - `emphasis`: `data-line-type` (`add` | `context` | `del`) - `empty` - `empty-half`: `data-side` (`left` | `right`) - `expand-button` - `expander` - `expander-label` - `file`: `data-file-name` (any value) - `file-header` - `file-title` - `gutter`: `data-line-type` (`add` | `context` | `del`), `data-selectable`, `data-selected` - `header` - `line`: `data-indicators` (`bars` | `classic`), `data-line-type` (`add` | `context` | `del`), `data-selected`, `data-side` (`left` | `right`) - `line-button` - `marker`: `data-line-type` (`add` | `context` | `del`) - `no-newline` - `revealed-row` - `root`: `data-diff-style` (`split` | `unified`), `data-file-count` (any value), `data-header` - `row` - `stat` - `stat-additions` - `stat-deletions` - `title` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### code-diff - `--cui-code-diff-radius`: `min( var(--radius-panel), calc(var(--control-h-xs) / 2 + var(--cui-code-diff-border-width) + var(--_code-corner-inset)) )` - `--cui-code-diff-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)` - `--cui-code-diff-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-code-diff-border-color`: `var(--control-rim)` - `--cui-code-diff-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-code-diff-header-background`: `var(--diff-gutter-bg)` - `--cui-code-diff-header-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-code-diff-foreground`: `var(--code-foreground)` - `--cui-code-diff-add-background`: `var(--diff-add-line)` - `--cui-code-diff-del-background`: `var(--diff-del-line)` - `--cui-code-diff-expand-button-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-code-diff-expand-button-background`: `transparent` - `--cui-code-diff-expand-button-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-code-diff-expand-button-shadow`: `none` - `--cui-code-diff-expand-button-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)` - `--cui-code-diff-expand-button-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-code-diff-selected-background`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.12)` - `--cui-code-diff-selected-gutter-background`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.24)` - `--cui-code-diff-gutter-hover-background`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.12)` - `--cui-code-diff-annotation-background`: `var(--background)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/code-diff - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/code-diff.json
